deterministic_selection: Sort 32 FIT reference IDs. At reference index i choose graycondition[(i//4)%2] (period 8) and RGBcondition[(i//8)%2] (period 16) to eliminate modulo-4 resonance with (i+j)%4. Choose clear anchor cases in the 2 complementary mask geometries and order each reference by canonical geometry index (lower_face, eye_band, image_left_lens, cheek_object).
deterministic_schedule: Group the 32 references into 8 four-reference groups by their 4-geometry role pattern in paired complementary order [0,2,1,3,4,6,5,7]. For turn 0..3, reference position j takes geometry index (turn+j)%4. Every cycle has 4 distinct refs, all 4 distinct geometries, 2 clear anchors, 1 GRAY augmented, and 1 RGB augmented.
